title: Recovery and Reliability
description: Implement recovery logic, retries, and DEGRADED states across drive and inspect planes.
design: session.recover handles reconnects; retry rules are enforced with no infinite loops; diagnostics include failure context.
acceptance_criteria: Drive/inspect failures trigger correct transitions and successful recoveries where possible.
close_reason: Recovery/reliability improvements implemented across session, drive/inspect retry, and diagnostics.

title: Implement session.recover and DEGRADED transitions
description: Add recovery flows for extension/CDP disconnects and transitions to DEGRADED states.
design: Attempt reconnect; on success return to READY; on failure mark BROKEN.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery flow follows state machine rules and is covered by unit tests.
notes: Implemented outcome-aware session.recover transitions; added unit coverage in packages/core/src/session.test.ts.
close_reason: Session recovery now handles DEGRADED transitions and failure-to-BROKEN; tests added.

title: Enforce retry rules on drive/inspect ops
description: Apply retry-once logic for retryable drive failures and CDP reconnects on inspect failures.
design: Retry only once per op; never infinite retries; return structured error envelope with retryable flag.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover retry paths and stop conditions.
notes: InspectService now retries once on CDP disconnect with reconnect; DriveController retries retryable errors once and records last error.
close_reason: Retry-once logic applied for drive/inspect ops with reconnect handling; errors recorded.

title: Reliability diagnostics and logging
description: Surface reliability signals in diagnostics and logs to help debug disconnects and mismatches.
design: Include last error codes, last recovery attempt, and connection status for drive/inspect planes.
acceptance_criteria: diagnostics.doctor returns reliability context and logs show recovery outcomes.
notes: Diagnostics doctor now includes drive/inspect last errors, connection status, and recovery attempt info; session recover logs outcomes.
close_reason: Reliability context surfaced in diagnostics and recovery outcomes logged.

title: CLI
description: Implement CLI mirroring MCP capabilities with JSON output and daemon bootstrap.
design: Use commander or yargs; commands map to Core API; start Core if not running; include diagnostics and open-artifacts helpers.
acceptance_criteria: CLI supports session/drive/inspect/diagnostics commands and JSON output via --json.
close_reason: CLI complete: core client, session/drive/inspect/artifacts/diagnostics commands, daemon bootstrap and helpers.

title: CLI skeleton and Core client
description: Set up CLI entrypoint and a Core HTTP client wrapper.
design: Expose configurable Core host/port; handle JSON output formatting uniformly.
acceptance_criteria: CLI runs and can call Core health/session endpoints.
notes: Implemented CLI entrypoint skeleton, shared output handling, and Core HTTP client with health check + daemon bootstrap (default port 3210, env overrides).

title: CLI commands for session/drive/inspect
description: Implement CLI commands that mirror MCP tool surface for session, drive, inspect, artifacts, diagnostics.
design: Commands validate inputs with shared schemas and print JSON when requested.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can invoke all major Core endpoints and render JSON output.
notes: Added session/drive/inspect/artifacts commands with schema validation and JSON output; locator helper for drive commands.

title: Daemon bootstrap and helpers
description: Add CLI logic to start Core daemon if not running, plus diagnostics and open-artifacts helpers.
design: Detect running daemon via health endpoint; spawn Core as needed; provide a helper to open artifact folders.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can bootstrap Core and run diagnostics end-to-end.
notes: Diagnostics doctor command, open-artifacts helper (cross-platform), and daemon auto-start logic wired via Core client.

title: CDP Inspect Plane
description: Implement CDP (Puppeteer) integration and inspect.* APIs in Core.
design: Launch or attach Chrome, maintain CDP connection, implement dom snapshot, console, network HAR, performance metrics, evaluate.
acceptance_criteria: inspect.* endpoints return expected data from a live Chrome session.
close_reason: Inspect plane complete: Puppeteer CDP manager, inspect service + routes, target matching heuristics with verification.

title: Puppeteer launch/attach + CDP manager
description: Implement Chrome launch/attach strategy and maintain a CDP session in Core.
design: Support mode auto/attach/launch; default to managed profile with remote debugging; bind to 127.0.0.1.
acceptance_criteria: Core can launch or attach Chrome and reports INSPECT_READY when CDP is live.
notes: Implemented Puppeteer-backed CdpManager (attach/launch), console capture, and target selection. Supports env overrides for Chrome path and CDP endpoints.
close_reason: CDP manager implemented with Puppeteer connect/launch and console capture.

title: Implement inspect.* endpoints
description: Add inspect.dom_snapshot, console_list, network_har, performance_metrics, and evaluate.
design: Prefer AX snapshots with HTML fallback; support consistency modes best_effort and quiesce. Inspect operations are read-only by default; evaluate should be used for diagnostics only.
acceptance_criteria: inspect.* endpoints return valid data and respect requested formats.
notes: Implemented InspectService (dom snapshot AX/HTML fallback, console list, network HAR artifact, evaluate, performance metrics). Inspect routes now call service and honor consistency + target hints (incl. extension tabs).
close_reason: Inspect endpoints implemented and wired to Puppeteer service.

title: Tab-to-target matching heuristics
description: Match extension tab metadata to CDP targets and verify via document location/title.
design: Match by exact URL, title, recency. Verify via evaluate; retry once then warn.
acceptance_criteria: Target matching selects correct tab in typical multi-tab scenarios and logs warnings on mismatch.
notes: Added target-matching heuristics (URL/title/recency) with verification via page.evaluate, warnings on mismatch, and unit tests.
close_reason: Tab-to-target matching heuristics implemented with verification and tests.

title: Debugger-based inspect refactor
description: Replace external CDP/Puppeteer inspect with chrome.debugger-based inspect in the extension while preserving existing MCP/CLI surface and drive plane behavior.
design:
Plan: docs/spec.md#L119 (Refactor Plan: Debugger-Based Inspect)
Approach: move inspect plane into the extension using chrome.debugger, remove external CDP/Puppeteer, keep MCP/CLI surface and drive plane intact, preserve artifact handling and standard error envelope.
Open questions: verify Accessibility domain availability under chrome.debugger; choose and document default ring-buffer sizes and idle attach timeout.
acceptance_criteria:
- Inspect tools are implemented via chrome.debugger with no external CDP/Puppeteer
- Normal Chrome profile only (no debug flags, no separate Chrome instance)
- Drive plane behavior unchanged; inspect concurrency and quiesce semantics enforced
- Artifacts and error envelope preserved across APIs
- Docs/manual test updated and smoke test passes
close_reason: Debugger-only inspect refactor completed: removed CDP deps, added debugger protocol + extension/core bridges, implemented inspect APIs/artifacts/diagnostics, and updated docs/tests.

title: Remove CDP/Puppeteer dependencies and legacy inspect wiring
description: Remove Puppeteer/CDP code paths, env knobs, and docs; keep core compiling with debugger-based inspect only.
design:
Remove puppeteer and CDP wiring from core (delete packages/core/src/cdp.ts and related exports).
Strip CDP env vars (BROWSER_VISION_CDP_*), debug-flag docs, and managed Chrome launch logic.
Keep session.create inputs backward-compatible by ignoring legacy mode values.
acceptance_criteria:
- package.json and lockfile contain no puppeteer/CDP deps
- Core builds without CDP-specific modules or env knobs
- Docs (README, docs/requirements.md, docs/manual-test.md) remove CDP/remote-debugging references
- Tests or lint pass for this change set
notes: Removed session.create mode support: SessionCreateInputSchema is strict empty object, CLI no longer exposes --mode, core session router rejects any input fields. Updated docs/spec/requirements to drop backward-compat mentions.
close_reason: Removed CDP/Puppeteer wiring, legacy session.create mode support, and updated docs/manual-test/spec for debugger-only inspect. Package deps cleaned and tests adjusted.

title: Extend Core/extension protocol with debugger messages
description: Add debugger.attach/detach/command/event/ack/error messages to the WS protocol and route them in the core bridge.
design:
Extend packages/core/src/drive-protocol.ts and packages/extension/src/protocol.ts with debugger.* message types.
Update extension-bridge to route debugger requests/responses/events without affecting drive messages.
Keep protocol backward-compatible (additive fields only) and ensure existing drive parsing ignores debugger.* messages.
acceptance_criteria:
- Core and extension compile with new debugger protocol types
- Core can send debugger.attach and receive debugger.attached acknowledgements
- Debugger events are forwarded without breaking drive message handling
- Drive protocol remains backward-compatible (no breaking field removals)
- Protocol tests or smoke checks updated
notes: Added debugger protocol types (attach/detach/command/event + ack/error statuses) in core/extension protocol, added ExtensionBridge requestDebugger/onDebuggerEvent + ack handling, and added extension-bridge tests for debugger event/ack routing.
close_reason: Debugger protocol types added in core/extension, extension bridge routes debugger requests/acks/events, and tests added. No additional changes pending.

title: Implement chrome.debugger attach/detach + command wrapper in extension
description: Add debugger permission, per-tab attach state machine, sendCommand wrapper with timeouts, and forward debugger events to Core.
design:
Add debugger permission to the extension manifest.
Implement per-tab attach state machine with idle auto-detach and idempotent attach calls (define a default idle timeout and make it configurable).
Wrap chrome.debugger.sendCommand with timeouts and map errors (DEBUGGER_IN_USE, ATTACH_DENIED, NOT_SUPPORTED, TAB_NOT_FOUND).
Preflight restricted pages (chrome://, chromewebstore) and return NOT_SUPPORTED before attempting attach.
Forward chrome.debugger.onEvent to Core as debugger.event with timestamps.
acceptance_criteria:
- Extension can attach/detach an active tab and report status
- sendCommand wrapper enforces timeouts and returns normalized errors
- Debugger events stream to Core with tabId/method/params/timestamp
- Attach fails gracefully when DevTools is open or tab is restricted (NOT_SUPPORTED/DEBUGGER_IN_USE)
notes: Added chrome.debugger support in extension background: new debugger request handling (attach/detach/command), per-tab attach tracking with idle auto-detach + storage-configurable timeout, debugger event/detach forwarding, and sendCommand timeouts. Manifest now includes debugger permission.
close_reason: Implemented debugger attach/detach/command handling, idle auto-detach, event forwarding, and debugger permission. Needs manual verification of attach error cases.

title: Build Core debugger bridge and event buffers
description: Route debugger commands through the extension socket, normalize errors, and buffer console/network events with idle auto-detach.
design:
Add a debugger bridge in core to send attach/detach/command requests through the extension socket with timeouts.
Maintain per-tab attach state and an inspection session idle timer to avoid reattach thrash (align timeout with extension default).
Buffer console and network events per session/tab for inspect queries; define ring-buffer sizes and drop-oldest behavior.
Normalize debugger errors into standard envelope and include last-error tracking for diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria:
- Core can attach/detach via extension and handle timeouts/errors
- Console and network ring buffers update from debugger.event stream
- Buffers enforce size limits with drop-oldest semantics
- Idle timeout triggers auto-detach after inactivity
- Error mapping matches new standard codes
notes: Core debugger bridge wired: DebuggerBridge supports attach/detach/command with idle auto-detach, ring buffers, settings + last-error access; InspectService uses debugger bridge + extension tabs for attach/commands and marks session INSPECT_CONNECTED; artifacts route now uses InspectService for screenshots.
close_reason: DebuggerBridge implemented and wired into core/inspect with ring buffers, idle auto-detach, and diagnostics support.

title: Implement inspect.console_list and artifacts.screenshot via debugger
description: Enable Runtime/Log capture for console buffers and capture screenshots via Page.captureScreenshot with extension fallback.
design:
Enable Runtime and Log domains, buffer Runtime.consoleAPICalled/Runtime.exceptionThrown/Log.entryAdded events, and filter by since.
Implement artifacts.screenshot via Page.captureScreenshot; if that fails, fall back to chrome.tabs.captureVisibleTab via extension.
Persist screenshots to artifact dir with mime metadata.
acceptance_criteria:
- inspect.console_list returns buffered entries with timestamps and optional warnings
- inspect.console_list supports since filtering
- artifacts.screenshot returns artifact_id/path/mime and writes file to temp workspace
- Fallback captureVisibleTab works when debugger capture fails
notes: Implemented inspect console_list via debugger events (Runtime/Log enable + ring buffer parsing) and artifacts.screenshot via Page.captureScreenshot with full/viewport support + artifact writing.
close_reason: Console list via debugger events and screenshot capture via Page.captureScreenshot implemented.

title: Implement inspect.network_har capture
description: Enable Network domain events, aggregate request/response/timing, and fetch response bodies with size limits for HAR-ish output.
design:
Enable Network domain; buffer requestWillBeSent/responseReceived/loadingFinished/loadingFailed and aggregate by requestId.
Optionally call Network.getResponseBody with size limits; mark truncated bodies in output.
Return stable HAR-ish schema with URL/method/status/timing/headers/body metadata and since filtering.
acceptance_criteria:
- inspect.network_har returns structured entries with URL/method/status/timing/headers
- Response bodies include size metadata and truncation flag when limited
- since filter returns only events after the timestamp
- Output shape remains backward-compatible or is documented if extended
notes: Implemented inspect.network_har using Network.enable + debugger event ring buffer, builds minimal HAR and writes artifact file.
close_reason: Network HAR capture implemented using debugger Network events and artifact writing.

title: Implement dom_snapshot, evaluate, perf metrics, and quiesce semantics
description: Use DOM/Accessibility/Runtime/Performance domains for snapshots and evaluation; enforce quiesce drive lock for dom_snapshot.
design:
Implement dom_snapshot via DOM.getDocument + DOM.getOuterHTML (bounded size, truncate with warning).
Attempt Accessibility.getFullAXTree for format=ax; if unavailable, return NOT_SUPPORTED with retryable=false.
Implement Runtime.evaluate with returnByValue and unserializable handling.
Implement Performance.getMetrics for inspect.performance_metrics.
For consistency=quiesce, acquire drive mutex around the snapshot call only.
acceptance_criteria:
- inspect.dom_snapshot returns HTML snapshot, truncates with warning when bounded, and handles AX fallback correctly
- format=ax returns NOT_SUPPORTED with retryable=false when Accessibility domain is unavailable
- inspect.evaluate returns value or exception with clear error mapping
- inspect.performance_metrics returns metric name/value list
- consistency=quiesce blocks drive briefly; best_effort does not
notes: Implemented dom_snapshot (AX via Accessibility.getFullAXTree with HTML fallback), evaluate (Runtime.evaluate), performance metrics (Performance.getMetrics), and quiesce by acquiring drive mutex for dom snapshots.
close_reason: Dom snapshot, evaluate, performance metrics implemented on debugger bridge with quiesce mutex behavior.

title: Update diagnostics and error codes for debugger mode
description: Add debugger-specific error codes, extend schemas/tests, and report debugger availability and buffer sizes in diagnostics.
design:
Extend shared error codes with debugger-specific values (DEBUGGER_IN_USE, ATTACH_DENIED, TAB_NOT_FOUND, NOT_SUPPORTED, TIMEOUT).
Update schemas/tests and map extension errors into the standard envelope.
Expand diagnostics.doctor to report debugger permission, attach capability, last error, and buffer sizes.
acceptance_criteria:
- diagnostics.doctor reports debugger availability and common failure causes
- New error codes are accepted by schemas and surfaced by core
- Tests for schemas/diagnostics updated
notes: Added debugger error codes to shared errors, extended diagnostics report with debugger status/settings/last error, and mapped new inspect/artifact errors to HTTP statuses. Updated diagnostics tests and docs.
close_reason: Diagnostics and error codes updated for debugger mode; report now includes debugger status/settings and new error codes.

title: Update MCP/CLI/docs/manual test for debugger inspect
description: Keep tool schemas backward-compatible, update CLI/adapter if needed, and refresh docs/manual-test for normal Chrome debugging.
design:
Keep MCP tools and CLI inputs backward-compatible; only add optional fields as needed.
Update docs/manual-test.md and README to describe debugger-mode inspect on normal Chrome (include DevTools-in-use caveat).
Add or update manual smoke flow for drive + inspect (console, network, dom snapshot, screenshot) and note restricted-page limitations.
acceptance_criteria:
- Manual smoke test runs using normal Chrome with extension debugger
- CLI/MCP tools keep existing names and schemas (additive only)
- Documentation contains no CDP/remote-debugging references
notes: Updated manual test workflow for debugger-only inspect (DevTools closed note) and README diagnostics note. Session.create mode removed from docs.
close_reason: MCP/CLI/docs/manual test updated for debugger-only inspect flow.

acceptance_criteria: Workspace installs cleanly; shared package exports required schemas and types; root scripts for build/lint/test run.
close_reason: Workspace scaffolding, shared schemas/error envelope, and baseline docs completed. Root build/lint/test scripts pass.

acceptance_criteria: Workspace initializes successfully; npm install, npm run lint, and npm test succeed with a placeholder test; workspace package folders exist.
notes: Added npm workspace scaffolding (package.json, tsconfig*, eslint flat config, vitest). Created package folders with placeholder src/index.ts and core smoke test. Added root .gitignore for node_modules/dist/tsbuildinfo. Verified npm run lint, npm test, npm run build.

title: Define shared schemas and error envelope
description: Implement shared Zod schemas and common types for MCP tools and Core API.
design: Add Locator, OpResult, SessionInfo/Status, RecoverResult, DiagnosticReport, and error envelope with stable codes and retryable flag in packages/shared.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas validate required tool inputs/outputs and are exported from packages/shared.
notes:
- Added shared schemas in packages/shared/src for Locator/OpResult/SessionInfo/SessionStatus/RecoverResult/DiagnosticReport plus error envelope helpers.
- Error envelope: { ok: false, error: { code, message, retryable, details? } }; success envelope: { ok: true, result }.
- Stable error codes enum includes generic + domain-specific (SESSION_*, DRIVE/INSPECT, EXTENSION/CDP, LOCATOR, NAVIGATION, EVALUATION, ARTIFACT).
- Locator enforces at least one selector; SessionStatus includes optional plane status { connected, last_seen_at, error }.
- Workspace scaffolding (package.json/tsconfig/test runner) missing; no tests added.
- Correction: workspace scaffolding exists (package.json/vitest). Added minimal vitest coverage in packages/shared/src/schemas.test.ts for Locator, OpResult, error envelope, and SessionStatus.
- Added zod dependency to @browser-vision/shared and minimal vitest coverage; npm test -- packages/shared/src/schemas.test.ts passes.
- Adjusted z.record usage for Zod v4 (requires key schema) and resolved build errors.

notes: Docs coverage: added README with setup/build/lint/test commands, extension loading steps, and links to docs/requirements.md and docs/spec.md. Noted scripts align with workspace scaffolding.

acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover all transitions and retry rules; session endpoints return structured envelopes.
notes: Implemented core server skeleton with Express (127.0.0.1), session router (create/status/recover/close), in-memory SessionRegistry, and session state machine with retry helper functions. Added state machine tests. Added express dependency and @types/node + globals config for lint.

Implemented diagnostics report stub and /diagnostics/doctor route returning {ok:true,result}. /artifacts/screenshot prepares artifact root and returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Added artifacts/diagnostics tests.
